explication_en: fck-nat builds an AWS NAT instance AMI: Packer (fck-nat.pkr.hcl) with the per-architecture variables installs the fck-nat.service service that runs fck-nat.sh at startup. The mkdocs documentation (deploying, configuration) explains the deployment.
